title: Corrective Action
description: Corrective action record linked to a Safety Finding

legal_basis.description: Applicable law articles — minimum 3 regulatory sources, inherited from linked finding

agent_id.description: Optional (v2.1): agent attribution. Not required because legacy records predate agent attribution and carry no audit_trail to derive it from (zero-fabrication rule).

workflow_id.description: Optional (v2.1): workflow execution reference. Corrective actions are tracked per finding, not per workflow dispatch — never invent an ID to satisfy this field.
